_meta.purpose: The TDLR program catalog: powers the /texas coverage section and the Licenses stage. Real TDLR program names, typed from tdlr.texas.gov — NOT invented, but NOT yet independently verified against the live site.
_meta.verify_note: REVIEW BEFORE DEMO: confirm each program name against https://www.tdlr.texas.gov/ and prune anything TDLR has sunset. A wrong program name here walks someone into a packet for a license that does not exist.
_meta.demo_depth: PRD: curate the demo around Barbering & Cosmetology, Air Conditioning & Refrigeration, and Electricians. Breadth is real; depth is curated.
_meta.no_guidelines_here: This file is the CATALOG only. Per-license crime categories (data/tdlr_guidelines.json) are deliberately ABSENT — quoting TDLR's guidelines requires parsing their published document, a separate reviewed task. Until then the UI links to TDLR's guidelines page, attributed. Never invent a category.

other_boards._note: Occupations people commonly ask about that TDLR does NOT license. Names only — no URLs until verified. Three-state honesty: covered here / known other board / unknown ('we don't have information on that one — check TDLR's site'). A confident wrong answer is the harm A14 exists to prevent.
